mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO challenge_participants (challenge_id, user_id, progress, joined_at) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{userId}, 0, #{joinedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM challenge_participants WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT challenge_id, user_id, progress, completed_at, joined_at FROM challenge_participants WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.description, c.image_url, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.goal_type, c.goal_value, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at, p.progress, p.completed_at, p.joined_at FROM challenge_participants p JOIN challenges c ON c.id = p.challenge_id
ORDER BY p.joined_at DESC, p.challenge_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM challenge_participants p JOIN challenges c ON c.id = p.challenge_id

SELECT p.challenge_id, p.user_id, p.progress, p.completed_at, p.joined_at FROM challenge_participants p JOIN challenges c ON c.id = p.challenge_id WHERE p.completed_at IS NULL AND c.end_date >= #{from} AND c.end_date < #{until} ORDER BY p.challenge_id, p.user_id

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.goal_type, c.goal_value FROM challenge_participants p JOIN challenges c ON c.id = p.challenge_id WHERE p.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.completed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF p
